features.goal: Create a new book — name it, seed Sommaire + isolated Mort, and land in the editor.
key_architecture_choices: BookService owns the single atomic seed factory (exactly Sommaire + isolated locked Mort, 0 edges) — KR-001/KR-002.
Create flow orchestrated by useCreateBook through brain only: createBook (persist + book:created) -> openBook (book:opened) -> Router.navigate, guaranteeing listeners see a persisted book (KR-004).
BookService emits domain events (the mutation owner) so features never emit domain events directly.
Modal primitive owns scrim/Esc dismiss + focus capture/restore + focus trap, shared by all future dialogs.
Validation computed inline in NewBookDialog (no useEffect derived state, KR-013).
lessons_learned: react/no-unescaped-entities flags raw apostrophes in JSX text — use the typographic apostrophe in French copy.
Iteration 3 (cloud-first offline queue) blocked on the cloud-sync feature / CloudSyncService not yet existing; left planned.

features.goal: Render the open book as a navigable graph of node cards + labelled edges on a dot-grid canvas, with single-select and the « + Nœud » entry point — the primary editor surface (wireframe § 02).
key_architecture_choices: The canvas is a pure VIEW over BookService (KR-020): useOpenBook subscribes to the brain event bus and re-reads the persisted book via useSyncExternalStore — an external-store subscription, not a useEffect-synced mirror (KR-013).
Node mutation lives in BookService (the SSOT): addNode creates a free-floating node with a deterministic auto-layout slot (autoSlot, KR-023), persists, then emits node:created carrying the kind.
Selection is owned by the canvas (single source of truth, KR-024) and broadcast via node:selected{nodeId|null}; node-editor will react to it.
Pure, testable geometry (resolvePositions/resolveEdges): position-less nodes fall back to autoSlot; orphaned edges are dropped, never drawn to nowhere (KR-021).
node:created payload extended with a typed kind on the brain EventBus — a core domain event emitted by BookService, kept in brain (emitter-owned).
lessons_learned: Inheriting code-knowledge.json from another project left foreign KR ids (KR-001 = cloud-import-options) that collide with the gamebook's own KR namespace — the cross-project knowledge base needs a reset/namespacing before appending gamebook KRs.
Local pan/zoom is shippable without UIPreferencesService; only its PERSISTENCE must wait — split iteration 3 so the canvas is usable now (mirrors book-creation iter 3 deferring on CloudSyncService).
Canvas event flow: node cards / controls must stopPropagation on pointerdown+click so background pan/clear-selection only fire on true empty-canvas interactions.
